Aisha (PM): Quick standup on Console Observability Q3 planning. We need a narrow Phase 1 that surfaces cost, latency, and error signals without huge infra spend. Propose dashboards + lightweight tracing hooks + nightly cost rollups. Thoughts?

Tom (Eng): Sounds good. Main concern is cardinality and query latency if we index too many tags. Recommend limiting indexing to model_id, route, customer_id for Phase 1.

Priya (SRE): Agree on limited tags. For traces, use a short trace envelope with these fields and do server-side sampling. Default retention 14d; enterprise customers can opt for longer. Need clear cost guardrails.

Diego (Data): For cost attribution: token usage already tagged per-tenant and per-route. Plan: compute daily aggregates per-customer and keep per-request samples for top 0.1% cost events for drill-down. That keeps dashboards cheap.

Maya (Design): UX guideline: three panels only on the initial page: "Cost (24h)", "Latency (p50/p95)", and "Errors (rate / top signatures)". Drill paths to hotspot explorer and trace detail.

Eli (Sales): For pilots make sure we include one PLG customer and one enterprise with compliance requirements. They'll want CSV export for cost rows.

Aisha (PM): Draft Phase 1 scope: 1) Overview dashboard with the three panels (cost/latency/errors). 2) Trace hook: add model_id, route, customer_id, routing_reason. 3) Nightly cost rollup job (per-customer, per-route). 4) Simple error grouping + top 20 signatures. Sampling: 1% success traces, 100% error traces. Retention 14d. Launch criteria: 3 pilot tenants, dashboard median query <600ms, telemetry cost increase <=10%.

Tom (Eng): Implementation detail: add trace header e.g. `X-RW-OBS: model=redwood-v1;route=/generate;reason=fallback`. We'll propagate as part of request context and emit to telemetry sink.

Priya (SRE): Sampling rules: default 1% for successes; escalate to 5% for high-value customers on dedicated clusters. Also put in budget alert: if telemetry spend exceeds threshold, auto-reduce sampling.

Diego (Data): Metric names planned: `console.cost.daily`, `console.latency.p50`, `console.latency.p95`, `console.error.rate`, and `console.traces.sampled`. Will export daily CSVs for ops and customers.

Maya (Design): I'll produce quick mockups and an interactive prototype linked in ticket. Keeping visuals minimal to avoid scope creep.

Aisha (PM): Risks callout: embeddings attribution (diff token semantics) is messy -> defer to Phase 2. High-cardinality route names could explode -> normalize route names in ingestion.

Tom (Eng): Action items for engineering: 1) Tracing header + propagation (3w). 2) Sampling + storage quota enforcement (2w). 3) Dashboard prototype hitting aggregated endpoints (4w).

Priya (SRE): Ops: define SLOs for telemetry pipeline: 99th ingest latency <12s, processing success rate >99.5%. Add runbook skeleton to ticket.

Diego (Data): I'll run storage/cost estimates for 14d with 1% sampling and 100% error capture and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Eli (Sales): Please include CSV export and a simple note for pilots about what data we capture; legal will need opt-in details for extended retention.

console-bot: Ticket PRODOBS-520 created: "Observability Phase1 - dashboards, trace hooks, nightly cost rollups" assigned to @Tom (Eng), @Diego (Data).

Aisha (PM): Decisions: 1) Phase 1 = overview panels + trace header + nightly rollups + error grouping. 2) Sampling/defaults set (1%/100%). 3) Embeddings attribution deferred. 4) Launch criteria as above. Next sync Thursday 11am — add blockers to PRODOBS-520. :rocket:
